2610.08502.title: X-OPM: Explainable Automatic Digital On-Chip Power Modeling for Enhanced Robustness
2610.08502.paper_summary: Proactive power management systems reduce processor dynamic power through runtime power prediction and power-aware scheduling. Accurate, stable and low-overhead digital on-chip power meters (OPMs) are crucial for improving the prediction quality. Recent studies have explored various modeling methods, including using linear models, decision trees, and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to construct OPMs. However, most current approaches train models end-to-end without analyzing the physical interpretability of features, affecting their ability to generalize to unseen workloads. Grounded in the design principles of synchronous digital VLSI circuits, X-OPM introduces a robust feature engineering framework that uses tree-based models to capture feature interactions and linear models for prediction. It also incorporates a human-in-the-loop workflow to balance model accuracy against modeling effort. Evaluated on a commercial C906 vector processor, X-OPM consistently achieves $R^2 > 0.93$ across all workloads with sampling window size set below $8$ cycles. In contrast, state-of-the-art methods including APOLLO, COBIT, and standard MLPs fail to generalize across all test cases. Layout with commercial EDA tools shows that X-OPM incurs an area overhead below $0.1\%$, which is on par with lightweight tree-based and linear models, and significantly smaller than MLP-based models.
2610.08502.paper_summary_zh: 主動電源管理系統通過運行時電源預測和電源感知排程來減少處理器的動態功耗。準確、穩定且低開銷的數位片上電源計量器（OPMs）對於提高預測質量至關重要。最近的研究探討了各種建模方法，包括使用線性模型、決策樹和多層感知器（MLPs）來構建OPMs。然而，大多數當前的方法都是端到端訓練模型，而未分析特徵的物理可解釋性，這影響了它們對未見工作負載的泛化能力。基於同步數位VLSI電路的設計原則，X-OPM引入了一個穩健的特徵工程框架，使用基於樹的模型來捕捉特徵交互，並使用線性模型進行預測。它還結合了一個人機協作的工作流程，以平衡模型準確性與建模工作量。經過在商業C906向量處理器上的評估，X-OPM在所有工作負載中始終達到$R^2 > 0.93$，且取樣窗口大小設置在$8$個週期以下。相比之下，最先進的方法包括APOLLO、COBIT和標準MLPs在所有測試案例中無法泛化。使用商業EDA工具的佈局顯示，X-OPM的面積開銷低於$0.1\%$，這與輕量級的基於樹和線性模型相當，並且顯著小於基於MLP的模型。
